'''March 2001 Minneapolis tournament (27 March)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 27 March 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1975">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-hardcore-mirkwood-mn-3-27-01d1975/ hardcore-mirkwood-mn-3-27-01], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 29 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-29-hardcore-mirkwood-mn-3-27-01d1975/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
